prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Pleasanton CA for a checkup and cleaning?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — do you have any preferences I should use to pick one? For example:
- Your ZIP code or part of Pleasanton (east/west)
- Whether you need someone who accepts a particular insurance (Delta, MetLife, Cigna, etc.)
- Any special needs (anxious patients, children, sedation, weekend hours)

If you want a quick answer now, here’s a practical way to find the “best” dentist for a routine checkup and cleaning, and what to check for when choosing:

How to find the best dentist for a checkup/cleaning
- Search recent Google and Yelp reviews for “dentist Pleasanton CA” and sort by rating and number of reviews. Look for consistent praise of gentle cleanings, thorough exams, friendly hygienists, and good appointment availability.
- Use appointment-booking sites (Zocdoc) to see real-time availability and new-patient reviews.
- Check provider credentials and disciplinary history on the California Dental Board website (search by dentist name).
- Confirm they take your insurance or offer a reasonable new-patient price if paying out of pocket.
- Ask about hygiene protocols (COVID/air filtration, sterilization), whether they use digital X-rays, and what their recall schedule is.

What to ask when you call
- “Do you accept [your insurance] for cleanings/exams?”
- “Are you accepting new patients and how soon is the first appointment?”
- “Who performs the cleaning — an RDH (dental hygienist) or the dentist?”
- “What is your approach to routine cleanings (frequency, scaling/polishing, fluoride) and do you charge separately for X‑rays?”
- “Do you have experience with anxious patients / sedation if needed?”

Red flags to avoid
- Lots of very recent negative reviews about billing surprises or rushed care.
- Clinics that pressure you into costly procedures without clear diagnostics.
- Inability to verify license or frequent staff turnover.

If you want, tell me your ZIP code and insurance (or whether insurance isn’t a concern) and I’ll give a short list of highly rated practices near you and a recommended first appointment to book.
